import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = 0
    start = 0
    length = len(input_line)
    
    while start < length:
        end = start
        ch = input_line[start]
        while end < length and input_line[end] == ch:
            end += 1
        group_size = end - start
        if group_size % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        start = end
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
